title: The Screaming Wall
text: A wall is built of the damned, their bodies mortared together, still alive and screaming, hands clawing out between the stones. Their faces press toward you as you pass. One of them calls a Scion by name over and over, in a voice they know.

options.label: The one being called answers the voice, to learn who knows their name.

outcomes.text: It is an ancestor. He tells them a secret of the House before the wall swallows him back.
It is a liar who only wanted to be heard. Now he will not stop.

options.label: Pull him free of the wall, whatever he is.

outcomes.text: He comes out, and the wall comes after him.

options.label: Stop your ears and walk on; nothing in that wall can be saved.

outcomes.text: You hear it for a day after, the name most of all.
